description.text: There is an entry examination in late August.

duration.text: The Organic Chemistry at Yunnan University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.No criminal record. observe the laws and decrees of China and the regulations of University, and respect the folkways and customs of Chinese. 2.Be in good health. 3.Applicants should be Master's degree graduate or the equivalent. 4.Applicants have Chinese proficiency of HSK grade 6 or above.
